methodology: Post-cutoff PDB structural-novelty cohort. Experimental and predicted target coordinates share sequence and observed residue identities; predicted coordinates are aligned offline by explicit C-alpha correspondence for visualization only. Prediction accuracy qualifies the panel and is not a binder endpoint. Binder comparison results remain pending until the four production workers complete.
limitations: Foldseek novelty is maximum detected query-length-normalized similarity to an available pre-cutoff PDB reference, not an exhaustive reconstructed training-manifest comparison.
Prediction confidence (pTM/pLDDT) is shown separately from measured TM-score and C-alpha lDDT.
Designed proteins are eligible and labeled; distillation independence is not claimed.
The viewer provides computational structural comparison and no wet-lab validation.

provenance.source_snapshot: Qualification/prediction evidence is retained in the approved S3 experiment topic; public assets contain only curated structures and annotations.
